package.name: mujoco_ground_slam_nn_nav
package.description: MuJoCo 3.12.0 + ROS Noetic ground vehicle assignment: physically simulated differential-drive vehicle, 360-degree lidar, RGB-D/BEV cameras, online occupancy-grid SLAM, A* navigation, and NumPy neural networks for perception, planning, control and end-to-end vision-based driving.
